questions.question: What is the objective of basketball?
options: To score points by throwing the ball into the hoop
To score points by kicking the ball into the hoop
To score points by running the ball into the hoop
To score points by throwing the ball out of bounds
questions.correct_answer: To score points by throwing the ball into the hoop

questions.question: What is a foul in basketball?
options: When a player commits a penalty
When a player breaks the rules
When a player scores a point
When a player makes a free throw
questions.correct_answer: When a player breaks the rules
